errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the order of categories on the y-axis as starting from Top100 at the top. The image clearly shows the order is from Top1000 at the top down to Top100 at the bottom.

The machine-generated description underestimates the values for the '介动紧密度' (orange) bars for Top900 and Top1000. Visually, Top900 is approximately 25 (not 22) and Top1000 is approximately 35 (not 30).
